node.statement: Opposite-product defect: for W in calU and R as in 1.2.1, exact unitality and the associator axiom give ||R-W^dagger||=||(W^dagger bold-dot W) bold-dot R-W^dagger bold-dot (W bold-dot R)||<=epsilon_r||W||^2||R||. Thus epsilon_r||W||^2<=1/15 implies ||R||<=15||W||/14. Since J=W bold-dot R, the product-norm axiom and ||W^dagger||=||W|| yield ||W bold-dot W^dagger-J||=||W bold-dot(W^dagger-R)||<=epsilon_r*(1+epsilon_r)||W||^3||R||<=((17/16)*(15/14)*(256/225))*epsilon_r<=2*epsilon_r.
